results.title: Die Zukunft ist Vergangenheit
results.overview: In March 2025, the Zurich cultural institution «Zukunft» was forced to close its doors for good. This prompted Stephan Schulz and Julian Kirchner to produce an independent, community-funded documentary. They document the final days of «Zuki» and the essence that made this gathering place so special.

results.title: What the Crows Saw
results.overview: A Pueblo woman finds herself in a mysterious tavern while searching for her missing sister.

results.title: Myth Schalke - A life long
results.overview: Mythos Schalke tells the story of the 2025/26 season, spanning the battle in the second division to FC Schalke 04's return to the Bundesliga.

results.title: God Hunter
results.overview: In a world where beings from myth and folklore have entered our realm, an undercover cop infiltrates a trafficking ring that smuggles and sells these beings to find his son.

results.title: Bigfoot Lover
results.overview: A heartbroken and lonely Cute is struggling to escape self-destructive patterns in her love life when she meets Bigfoot.

results.title: Nintama Rantaro the Stage: ~Minna Nikoniko, Hai, Douzo! no Dan~
results.original_title: 舞台「忍たま乱太郎」〜みんなニコニコ、はい、どうぞ！の段〜
results.overview: The fourth Nintama Rantaro The Stage installment.

results.title: Forglemmegei
results.overview: Martin lives alone with his memories, but even they are starting to slip away. His grandchild, Teodor, gives him something to fill the void in his life, and it works — for a while.

results.title: The Barn Part III
results.overview: Years after the events of 'The Barn Part II', the group is still left in fear that the evil three might come back to finish the harvest once and for all.

results.title: Jiřina Bohdalová: A jede se furt dál...
results.original_title: Jiřina Bohdalová: A jede se furt dál...

results.title: Nari Choritro Bejay Jotil
results.overview: During a Kali Puja night, Jhantu mysteriously gains the ability to hear women's inner thoughts, a power that first unsettles him but soon reveals the vulnerabilities and unspoken battles they carry.

results.title: End of the Line
results.overview: End of the Line is an anthology of three short films (The Brief Case of Maya Moon, The Red Widow, and The Extraordinary Experience of Dick Shatner), all of which take place on one reality defying steam train.

results.title: The Law of Karma
results.overview: Camilla is a karmic astrologer. She believes in past lives and reincarnation, but her karma keeps her away from Jean... until a revelation changes the course of events.

results.title: Who Is Still Alive
results.overview: A map of Gaza, its towns, camps and neighbourhoods. White paint on a black ground. Within the crudely drawn outlines, nine refugees who escaped the inferno tell their stories.

results.title: A Fistful of Feathers
results.overview: Divorced father Borko shows up at his daughter Anja's birthday party dressed as a cowboy. After making a fatal mistake, his already fragile relationships unravel, and the line between his western fantasies and reality begins to tear.

results.title: Tumbleweed
results.overview: Amidst fields of Arabica beans, Hurle, a young woman, dreams of a future beyond the coffee shop where she works to support her mother. Her life is disrupted when she goes in pursuit of an eccentric petty thief who will turn her daily life upside down.

results.title: Hotel Excelsior
results.overview: A mysterious concierge guides us through stories that unfold in the same room over a century. A Jewish businessman celebrates a lonely family festivity with his daughter. A planned suicide leads to a life-changing encounter. An ageing rock band struggles with their image, and a young woman sees a callboy as her big chance for financial independence.

results.title: Mexican Delight
results.overview: When Luz, a devout Catholic, is plagued by unsettling dreams, she becomes desperate to stay awake at all costs.

results.title: A Neighbor to Die For
results.overview: To help complete her latest novel, Courtney rents a nearby house, only to be greeted by Jon and Jodie, two strangers who claim to be caretakers in the owner's absence. As Courtney settles in, she can't shake the feeling that something is terribly off.
